title: update-input
description: Discriminated-union schema with one entry per script in executing-plans/scripts/ (entry title = script name). Each script dispatches by filename, so the 'op' field is implicit. Documentation only: the scripts validate their own input (scripts/_apply_op.py) and ignore keys they do not read, so keys starting with '_' are free annotations. tests/test_update_input_schema.py holds this file to the code.

oneOf.title: run-step
oneOf.description: Bundled start + shell exec + complete/fail with AUTO-CAPTURED log_context. Preferred path for COMMAND/CODE/TEST steps — eliminates the 'forgot to pass log_context' footgun. Exits with the wrapped command's true exit code; auto-fail-step on non-zero. Output truncated to 16 KiB (head 8 KiB + marker + tail 8 KiB).

command.description: Passed verbatim to `bash -c $command`. Heredocs/pipes/&&/|| all allowed.

summary.description: Optional ONE-line curated summary. Defaults to 'run-step: <command-truncated-80>'.

allow_nonzero.description: Reserved for future use. v1 must be false or absent — non-zero always auto-fail-steps.

metrics_from_stdout.description: Phase 7: record every captured line `metric name=<x> value=<v> [unit=<u>]` through the record-metric op (project = the step's plan's project). Non-numeric values are skipped with a stderr note.

oneOf.title: record-metric
oneOf.description: Phase 7: one NUMERIC observation into the append-only metrics table (migration 017). The metric outcome channel judges an expectation `metric:<name>` against the nearest row before and after it. value must be a number — a model cannot write a metric in words.

value.description: A JSON number (or a strictly numeric string); anything else exits non-zero and writes nothing.

project.description: Defaults to the plan's Plans.project (via plan_id, or step_id -> its plan). Required when neither resolves.

source.description: Defaults to 'record-metric'; run-step's stdout capture writes 'run-step'.

oneOf.title: start-step
oneOf.description: PENDING → IN_PROGRESS. Optionally sets step_type, agent_input, and inline log_context (e.g. process launch banner).

agent_input.description: Required when type=SUB_AGENT — the verbatim prompt sent to the delegated agent

log_context.description: Optional initial log entry (e.g. launch banner, kickoff timestamp). Same format as append-log.

oneOf.title: complete-step
oneOf.description: IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED. Optionally records summary, agent_output, and inline log_context (raw shell/tool output — same path as append-log).

summary.description: ONE human-curated sentence describing what was done. Distinct from log_context.

agent_output.description: Required when this step had type=SUB_AGENT — the agent's response

log_context.description: Optional raw output (shell stdout, test output, tool log). Appended to Steps.log_context with `--- ts ---` delimiter — same format as append-log.sh. Use this INSTEAD OF a separate append-log call when you have the output ready at completion time.

oneOf.title: fail-step
oneOf.description: * → FAILED. Reason appended to log_context. Optional inline log_context for the failure output (highly recommended — explains WHY).

log_context.description: Optional raw failure output (stack trace, error log). Strongly recommended for failures — the dashboard shows it in the step's log panel.

oneOf.title: append-log
oneOf.description: Append raw machine output to Steps.log_context (auto-truncated). No status transition.

text.description: Raw output to append. Telemetry truncates to last ~50 lines / ~1000 tokens.

oneOf.title: deviate
oneOf.description: Mid-flight plan revision. Inserts new sub-steps under parent + increments revision_count. Circuit breakers: revision_count ≤ max_revisions, depth ≤ 3.

justification.description: Why the plan needed to change. Logged for audit.

oneOf.title: record-skill
oneOf.description: INSERT into SkillActivations. Use for skills loaded mid-flight (source typically 'deferred-load'). For init-time skills, use writing-plans/publish-plan.sh's skills[] array instead.

name.description: Skill name as the Skill tool lists it, e.g. 'systematic-debugging'

step_id.description: Optional — anchor activation to the step where it surfaced

reason.description: Optional — short note on what triggered the activation

oneOf.title: raise-budget
oneOf.description: FL-137: raise a plan's max_revisions ceiling after the loop breaker refused a deviate. Only upwards, `reason` REQUIRED, and the raise is appended to the plan's record as a Deviations row (target_step_id NULL) — a new ceiling is a decision about the plan, not a column to edit. revision_count is untouched: the raise does not spend the budget it grants.

new_max.description: The new ceiling. Must be GREATER than the plan's current max_revisions; anything else exits non-zero and writes nothing.

reason.description: Why these extra revisions are warranted. Required — blank is refused.

oneOf.title: finish-plan
oneOf.description: Usually unnecessary: a plan closes itself when its last regular step terminates. Runs the deterministic review; a legacy plan (no review step) or one with steps still PENDING is force-completed; a plan in NEEDS_REVIEW is refused (exit 7) — drive its <plan>-REVIEW.1 child instead.

oneOf.title: agent-review-close
oneOf.description: Fallback finalizer for a plan whose review step is NEEDS_REVIEW (or FAILED with a recovered REVIEW.1 child, outcome pass). The normal path is to complete-step / fail-step the <plan>-REVIEW.1 child. pass -> review step + plan COMPLETED; fail -> both FAILED. Any other review state exits non-zero.

summary.description: One sentence; becomes the review step's summary and is logged with the [AGENT-REVIEW PASS|FAIL] tag.

log_context.description: The review's details, appended to the review step's log.

oneOf.title: reason-slots
oneOf.description: Read the close-time checklist for a registered-project plan: the changed nodes that still need a reason, plus what the rules already filled. Exit 6 when the project has no built state graph.

draft.description: Also propose, per open slot, recorded utterances that mention the node — ready to send back as stated answers.

oneOf.title: reason-fill
oneOf.description: Record one answer per changed node. The tier follows from the answer's shape. The old {node_key, text} shape exits 2; a node_key outside the plan's change set exits 6; nothing is written on either.

run_id.description: The run the slots came from (reason-slots output).

utterance_id.description: stated: with span, points at the user's recorded words.

span.description: stated: [start, end] character offsets inside the utterance.

refs.description: asserted: reference ids (an email, a ticket, a note registered with `provledger note`).

because.description: Any shape: reason ids this change leaned on; each becomes influence(via=reason_because).

oneOf.title: headline-respond
oneOf.description: Answer one blocking finding of the plan's latest headline. The finding's record and every cited record become influence(via=headline_response). A second answer to the same finding exits 2.
